libheif-js 1.23.5, LGPL-3.0. Unmodified: libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.js from npm. It contains libheif and
libde265, both LGPL-3.0, compiled to WebAssembly. To use your own build, replace this one file.
Source: https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js, https://github.com/strukturag/libheif,
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265
